graph_root_policy: Select specimen-supported common-tree endpoints after geometry is fixed; identity coverage audited only. No tissue/CNV/function columns available. Slingshot uses actual saved Monocle2 root clusters.

dynamic_genes.aggregation: Capture-bin means of log1p(CP10K), then equal capture means within each specimen-bin; all specimens retained
dynamic_genes.model: Specimen-fixed-intercept WLS with cubic B-spline time basis; within each specimen observed bins have equal weights summing to one. Basis degree3, interior knots1/3 and2/3, drop first of6 columns, five time coefficients.
dynamic_genes.covariance: Cluster-robust CR1 by supported reported subject_key; unsupported links grouped into one conservative unknown cluster per dataset. These are reported linkage units, not verified independent patients.
dynamic_genes.test: Joint five-coefficient Wald F, F(5,G-1), singular covariance recorded unassessable. BH over all detection-eligible tested measured genes, separately for each root.
dynamic_genes.limitations: Conditional association with a data-derived trajectory; no independent validation of pseudotime and no longitudinal or causal inference.

modules.input: Within-gene Z scores of specimen-intercept-adjusted spline trajectories on supported bins; no tissue/CNV/function labels
modules.algorithm: All selected genes, deterministic multi-start kmeans; no biological cell sampling
modules.selection: Maximum silhouette among K with median adjusted-Rand stability >=0.75 across 10 bootstrap draws of whole linkage clusters stratified by dataset; if none, report instability and choose highest median stability then silhouette. No GO-based tuning.
modules.representatives: Closest genes to module centroid, deterministic gene-name tie break; up to3 per module
modules.root_sensitivity: Alternate-root gene statistics, selection overlap, module profiles and concordance after cell-ID orientation assessment
modules.method_sensitivity: All Slingshot primary/alternative paths: specimen-equal module and representative-gene trends with actual coverage and weights, no favorable-path selection
modules.cohort_sensitivity: Refit binned-expression dynamic model and module profiles leaving each dataset out; fixed common graph, not a claim of re-trained Harmony or curves

GO.annotation_source: Official NCBI human gene_info and gene2go; GO basic ontology from Gene Ontology; versions, URLs and SHA256 frozen before enrichment
GO.mapping: Exact official symbols first; only unambiguous synonyms for unresolved symbols; all mapping fates saved
GO.ontology: Biological Process; exclude NOT and ND; propagate is_a and part_of to BP ancestors
GO.background: Only the measured genes passing the frozen detection preconditions; all unmapped backgrounds and effective annotation coverage disclosed
GO.test: One-sided hypergeometric overrepresentation; BH over all module-term tests
GO.display_redundancy: Greedy BH order, omit ancestor/descendant redundancies or hit-set Jaccard >=0.5; no significant term means no enriched GO term

path_dynamics.unit_hierarchy: capture -> specimen -> supported reported label, equally weighted at each step; unsupported proxies separate
path_dynamics.Slingshot_membership: finite path PT and native weight >=0.5
path_dynamics.empty_bins: NA gaps, never zero or bridged

CNV_tissue_interpretation: Shared-identity and within-CRC unit-equal comparisons plus frozen CRC-only outputs by exact cell_id; no CNV progression claim from source composition
visual_review: Every formal PNG actually opened and every PDF page rendered and actually opened; bind observations to file SHA256
